Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and any changed architecture decision.

### Verified

List the exact commands run, their outcomes, and the environment. For meaningful behavior
tests, identify the failure observed before the fix. Explain focused checks used for simple
changes. Name platforms or clients that remain unverified.

### Documentation

Identify the paired guide changes, or the committed `Docs-not-needed:` explanation.

### Accessibility

For rendered UI changes, report keyboard operation, visible focus, loading and error feedback,
contrast, reflow, and the browser scan. State any manual screen reader evidence and documented
exceptions. Remove this section when the change has no rendered output.
